incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident MODEL-CATALOG-REVISION-MISMATCH triggered (PD #INC-7234)

pagerduty: Page sent to oncall@sre (ack deadline 5m)

Sasha: acked. I'm on it. Paging in thread.

pagerduty: Acknowledged by Sasha

Priya: saw alert spike. Initial signal: 5xx rate from hosted inference when using model 'redwood/fastchat-v2' variant 'rev-202603'. Errors look like tokenizer failures ("Invalid token sequence") from the serving runtime.

Mike: confirming, CloudFronts show 400s with payload:
```
{"error":"tokenize_failed","details":"unknown token at pos 12"}
```

Carla: any customer reports? Support: two customers reported chat truncation + 500s in last 20m. Notified Sales for impacted customers.

Sasha: root cause hypothesis: catalog promotion last night set default_revision -> rev-202603 but this revision used a different tokenizer config (byte-level vs bpe). Routing picked the new rev for default route. Need immediate mitigation: pin default->previous rev (rev-202598), and route traffic to fallback model 'redwood/fastchat-v2-compat'.

Dave: can do quick rollback via catalog API. Running:
```
curl -X POST https://catalog.internal/api/v1/promotions/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fastchat-v2","target_rev":"rev-202598"}'
```

Priya: also toggling autoset to disable auto-promo for this model: `catalogctl set auto_promo=false --model fastchat-v2` to prevent churn.

Sasha: Mike, can you flip routing rule to fallback (soft-fail) while rollback in progress? Command:
```
rotractl route set --model fastchat-v2 --route default --fallback redwood/fastchat-v2-compat
```

Mike: I'm on routing. Applied fallback rule at 2081234705. Verifying traffic now.

Carla: confirming error rate down ~70% for affected endpoints in last 3m. Customers still see some delayed errors while caches flush.

Priya: found config diff between revs:
```
"tokenizer": "byte-level",
"vocab_checksum": "abc123"
```
vs
```
"tokenizer": "bpe",
"vocab_checksum": "def456"
```
That explains mismatches in KV cache and tokenization leading to invalid token sequences.

Sasha: escalation check: PD policy says if >10% customer error or >2 customers with impact escalate to Eng-SRE lead. We have 2 customers + ~12% error, escalating to Eng-SRE lead @Mike and @Priya already in thread.

Mike: will own postmortem. For now, can we confirm rollback success?

Dave: rollback API returned 202 accepted; catalog job id 9876. Watching promotion job. Logs:
```
[2081234720] rollback_job_9876: started
[2081234758] rollback_job_9876: set default_rev=rev-202598
[2081234765] cache_invalidate: started for model fastchat-v2
[2081234789] cache_invalidate: done
```

Carla: Support notified customers that we're routing to fallback; provided link to status update doc.

Priya: reran a small batch of in-flight requests to validate tokenization: PASSED. No tokenize errors in 1000 samples.

Sasha: handing off to next oncall for follow-up and postmortem. Handoff notes:
- Incident: MODEL-CATALOG REVISION MISMATCH causing tokenizer errors
- Mitigation: applied fallback route, rolled back default_rev to rev-202598, disabled auto-promo
- Jobs: catalog rollback job 9876 complete, cache invalidation finished
- Customer impact: 2 customers reported issues, error rate peaked ~14%, now down to 3%
- Followups: postmortem (link in thread), ensure promotion gating includes tokenizer checksum compare, add e2e tokenization test to deployment pipeline

Sasha: @Priya @Mike handing over. Next oncall: Priya will take lead for postmortem. I'm clear to hand off in 10m.

Priya: acknowledged handoff. Will draft postmortem and assign action items.

pagerduty: Incident resolved by Sasha; status -> resolved at 2081234968

incident-bot: Incident closed. Tags: catalog, tokenizer, rollback, customer-impact

Sasha: thanks team :thumbsup:

Carla: chasing customers to confirm full recovery. Will update when final.
